designCorrection: Do not collapse pricing power into a single FULL/PARTIAL/NONE label before realized ASP/margin evidence exists.

clocks.sourcePublishedAt: native issuer timestamp/date if explicitly exposed, else UNKNOWN
clocks.firstEligibleTaiwanDecision: derived only after authoritative knownAt is frozen

costContext.note: Issuer narrative/benchmark context; not realized procurement cost.

postedPriceResponse.note: Classify across explicitly exposed relevant product rows, not company-wide by inference.

realizedAspResponse.note: Requires disclosed realized ASP or sufficiently scoped realized selling-price evidence.

realizedMarginResponse.note: Requires issuer-reported margin at its publication knownAt.

inferenceState.note: Never inferred from posted price alone.

classificationRules: Posted price BROAD does not equal realized full pass-through when realizedAspResponse is UNKNOWN.
Posted price SELECTIVE is not failure; product/customer demand and quoting cycles may differ.
Posted price NONE plus stable/expanded margin does not prove no pricing power because inventory/mix/input-cost relief may dominate.
Posted price UP plus compressed margin is direct counterevidence against using posted price as margin-protection proof.
A realized margin change without compatible product/volume/input-cost scope is CONFOUNDED, not pass-through success/failure.
Missing rows remain UNKNOWN and are excluded from any scope coverage ratio; absence is not zero adjustment unless issuer matrix explicitly shows 0.

adversarialFixtures.expected: realizedMarginResponse=COMPRESSED; posted pricing does not prove margin protection
cannot infer NO_PRICING_POWER; inventory/mix/input relief remain competing explanations
